title.id: Analisis Sentimen Ulasan Aplikasi Mobile JKN
title.en: Mobile JKN App Review Sentiment Analysis

projectTypeLabel.id: Proyek latihan dengan dataset publik (63.766 ulasan Google Play Store)
projectTypeLabel.en: Practice project with public dataset (63,766 Google Play Store reviews)

summary.id: Membangun pipeline klasifikasi sentimen end-to-end berbasis Python dengan kerangka Knowledge Discovery in Database (KDD) terhadap 63.766 ulasan Mobile JKN (Jan 2025 – Jan 2026). Menggabungkan Hybrid Labeling (Rating + InSet Lexicon), 15.000 fitur TF-IDF bigram, dan Multinomial Naive Bayes dengan akurasi 94,38% dan F1-score 94,86%, disajikan melalui dashboard interaktif.
summary.en: Built an end-to-end Python sentiment classification pipeline using the Knowledge Discovery in Database (KDD) framework on 63,766 Mobile JKN reviews (Jan 2025 – Jan 2026). Combined Hybrid Labeling (Rating + InSet Lexicon), 15,000 TF-IDF bigram features, and Multinomial Naive Bayes achieving 94.38% accuracy and 94.86% F1-score, presented via an interactive dashboard.

eyebrow.id: Case Study · Machine Learning & NLP · Mei 2026 – Juli 2026
eyebrow.en: Case Study · Machine Learning & NLP · May 2026 – July 2026

headline.id: Memilah 63.766 Ulasan Mobile JKN Menjadi Prioritas Perbaikan Produk dengan Akurasi 94,38%
headline.en: Sorting 63,766 Mobile JKN Reviews into Product Fix Priorities with 94.38% Accuracy

subheadline.id: Pendekatan Knowledge Discovery in Database (KDD) dan Hybrid Labeling (InSet Lexicon) untuk mengoreksi bias rating bintang serta memetakan keluhan spesifik pengguna.
subheadline.en: A Knowledge Discovery in Database (KDD) and Hybrid Labeling (InSet Lexicon) approach to correct star-rating bias and map specific user complaints.

description.id: Mengumpulkan 63.766 ulasan pengguna aplikasi Mobile JKN dari Google Play Store untuk rentang periode Januari 2025 – Januari 2026 mengikuti tahapan awal Knowledge Discovery in Database (KDD).
description.en: Collected 63,766 Mobile JKN user reviews from the Google Play Store spanning January 2025 – January 2026 following the initial stage of Knowledge Discovery in Database (KDD).

description.id: Menjalankan data cleaning (hapus duplikat, angka, simbol, URL), normalisasi kata tidak baku/slang bahasa Indonesia, stopword removal kontekstual, dan stemming selektif dengan pustaka Sastrawi.
description.en: Executed data cleaning (removing duplicates, numbers, symbols, URLs), Indonesian slang normalization, contextual stopword removal, and selective stemming using the Sastrawi library.

title.id: Data Transformation: Hybrid Labeling (Rating + InSet Lexicon)
title.en: Data Transformation: Hybrid Labeling (Rating + InSet Lexicon)

description.id: Mengatasi ketidaksesuaian antara bintang rating dan isi teks ulasan. Kombinasi skor bintang dan kamus leksikon bahasa Indonesia (InSet Lexicon) mengungkap 89% ulasan rating 3 berisi keluhan, serta mengoreksi label negatif pada 41% ulasan rating 4 dan 8% ulasan rating 5.
description.en: Resolved discrepancies between star ratings and review text. Combining star ratings with the Indonesian Sentiment Lexicon (InSet) revealed 89% of 3-star reviews were complaints, and corrected negative labels on 41% of 4-star and 8% of 5-star reviews.

title.id: Ekstraksi Fitur TF-IDF Bigram & Pemodelan Naive Bayes
title.en: TF-IDF Bigram Feature Extraction & Naive Bayes Modeling

description.id: Mengekstraksi 15.000 fitur kata TF-IDF bigram agar pasangan kata bermakna (seperti 'kode otp', 'verifikasi wajah') tertangkap utuh. Melatih model Multinomial Naive Bayes dengan pembagian data 80:20 (47.984 latih : 11.996 uji).
description.en: Extracted 15,000 TF-IDF bigram word features so meaningful phrase pairs (like 'otp code', 'face verification') were preserved. Trained a Multinomial Naive Bayes classifier using an 80:20 split (47,984 train : 11,996 test).

description.id: Menyajikan ringkasan eksekutif, tren sentimen bulanan sepanjang 13 bulan (Jan 2025 – Jan 2026), komposisi sentimen (52,5% positif vs 47,5% negatif), serta metrik evaluasi model pada dashboard interaktif.
description.en: Presented executive summaries, 13-month monthly sentiment trends (Jan 2025 – Jan 2026), sentiment composition (52.5% positive vs 47.5% negative), and model evaluation metrics in an interactive dashboard.

outputMetric.id: Identifikasi Login & Akun sebagai klaster keluhan #1
outputMetric.en: Identified Login & Account as the #1 complaint cluster

title.id: Anomali Rating Bintang vs Isi Teks Ulasan
title.en: Star Rating vs. Review Text Anomaly

sentence.id: Mengandalkan rating bintang semata menyesatkan analisis: 89% ulasan bintang 3 berisi keluhan nyata, bahkan 41% ulasan bintang 4 dan 8% ulasan bintang 5 menyampaikan kendala teknis yang berhasil dikoreksi oleh Hybrid Labeling.
sentence.en: Relying solely on star ratings misleads analysis: 89% of 3-star reviews contain real complaints, while 41% of 4-star and 8% of 5-star reviews report technical issues that Hybrid Labeling successfully corrected.

recommendation.id: Gunakan klasifikasi sentimen berbasis teks (Hybrid Labeling) sebagai metrik pemantauan rilis aplikasi, bukan sekadar rata-rata bintang Play Store.
recommendation.en: Use text-based sentiment classification (Hybrid Labeling) as the release health metric rather than raw Play Store star averages.

sentence.id: Analisis 15.000 fitur TF-IDF bigram dan word cloud mengidentifikasi Login & Akun sebagai kategori keluhan spesifik tertinggi, didominasi oleh kegagalan kode OTP, verifikasi wajah, dan verifikasi nomor ponsel.
sentence.en: Analysis of 15,000 TF-IDF bigram features and word clouds identified Login & Account as the highest specific complaint category, dominated by OTP failures, face verification, and phone number verification.

recommendation.id: Jadikan alur autentikasi (OTP, verifikasi wajah, dan nomor ponsel) sebagai prioritas utama perbaikan rekayasa produk.
recommendation.en: Make the authentication flow (OTP, face verification, and phone number validation) the top product engineering priority.

action.id: Audit latensi gateway SMS OTP dan tambahkan opsi kanal cadangan (seperti WhatsApp/Email OTP atau jeda kirim ulang yang jelas) untuk menekan kegagalan login.
action.en: Audit SMS OTP gateway latency and add fallback channels (such as WhatsApp/Email OTP or clearer retry timers) to reduce login failures.

expectedImpact.id: Menurunkan porsi keluhan terbesar pada klaster Login & Akun.
expectedImpact.en: Directly reduces the largest complaint driver in the Login & Account cluster.

action.id: Perjelas panduan pencahayaan kamera saat verifikasi wajah serta sediakan alur pembaruan nomor ponsel mandiri yang tervalidasi tanpa mengharuskan pengguna mengulang dari awal.
action.en: Improve camera lighting guidance during face verification and provide a validated self-service phone number update flow.

expectedImpact.id: Mengurangi friksi aktivasi akun peserta JKN di perangkat mobile.
expectedImpact.en: Reduces account activation friction for JKN members on mobile devices.

target.id: Pipeline Pemantauan Ulasan Berkala di Dashboard
target.en: Automated Review Monitoring Pipeline in Dashboard

action.id: Integrasikan model Multinomial Naive Bayes (akurasi 94,38%, recall 98,89%) ke dashboard pemantauan bulanan agar lonjakan keluhan pasca-update aplikasi langsung terdeteksi.
action.en: Integrate the Multinomial Naive Bayes model (94.38% accuracy, 98.89% recall) into monthly monitoring dashboards to detect complaint spikes immediately after app updates.

expectedImpact.id: Deteksi dini regresi fitur dengan recall tinggi (98,89%).
expectedImpact.en: Early detection of feature regressions with high recall (98.89%).

text.id: Aplikasi Mobile JKN menerima puluhan ribu ulasan pengguna yang tidak mungkin dibaca satu per satu secara manual. Selain itu, banyak pengguna memberikan rating bintang 3, 4, atau 5 tetapi menuliskan keluhan teknis di kolom komentar, sehingga rata-rata rating bintang tidak mencerminkan kepuasan sebenarnya.
text.en: The Mobile JKN app receives tens of thousands of user reviews that are impossible to audit manually. Furthermore, many users leave 3-, 4-, or 5-star ratings while writing technical complaints in the text, making raw star averages an unreliable indicator of user satisfaction.

text.id: Dengan kerangka Knowledge Discovery in Database (KDD), penerapan stemming selektif Sastrawi menjaga konteks kata, sementara Hybrid Labeling berbasis rating dan InSet Lexicon menghasilkan 59.980 data berlabel seimbang (31.470 positif / 52,5% dan 28.510 negatif / 47,5%) yang meningkatkan kualitas pelatihan Multinomial Naive Bayes.
text.en: Using the Knowledge Discovery in Database (KDD) framework, selective Sastrawi stemming preserved word context while Hybrid Labeling (rating + InSet Lexicon) produced 59,980 balanced labeled samples (31,470 positive / 52.5% and 28,510 negative / 47.5%) that boosted Multinomial Naive Bayes training quality.
